body:
The public surface mixed product narrative with test totals, source hashes and engineering acceptance commentary. This change leads with the product ideas and gives evaluation a durable destination.

Homepage order is Hero → atomic Spark/Attention → parallel Paper/Tour → recorded work and Review → Matter/Experts/Runtime → Eval. A source-change illustration connects rebuildable knowledge with consequential human attention; keyboard and reduced-motion changes are immediate. Navigation uses short Paper/Tour labels. Features, Eval and Experts are new pages; the remaining pages, README and replay framing use the same editorial standard.

Synthetic media, concept plans and planned eval families retain concise scope labels. Original evidence is unchanged. Benchmark method exports are included in the build identity and workflow triggers.

Validation: static build and byte-for-byte reproduction, syntax, local/pinned links, material inheritance, public-data projection and repository documentation links. Existing media was reused. No runtime implementation or public deployment is included.

Depends on the BM-01 contract branch in #1. The private career-kit resume was separately revised and compiled into two coordinated pages; no personal resume material is in this PR.

The final language pass removes Pi/AgentSession and dependency versions from public prose, retaining the internal architecture reference. Matter/Experts connect sources, responsibility, rules and decisions. The complete normalized data-organization conversation, content hashes, primary-source index and owner-aligned follow-up map are registered; Paper 9.6 remains unchanged because its Work Contract already covers the relevant responsibilities. This intake introduces no organization registry or policy/workflow runtime.
title: Pages: Spark and Attention first, with a product-facing Eval narrative

body:
Continuity already defines a working synthetic observation protocol. This PR extends it into a shared evaluation contract so future state-machine, fault and disclosure experiments answer a frozen question and retain reproducible evidence.

BM-01 defines claims, authentic operations, matched treatments, timing boundaries, independent observation, admission and evidence custody. BM-02–05 are ready implementation briefs with scope, dependencies and validation; this PR does not claim their implementation or new benchmark results.

Validation: repository documentation links and consistency with the existing Continuity protocol and D3 sequence. No runtime changes or paid model runs.
title: BM-01: Define the evaluation contract and prepare BM-02–05
